name: Suntec Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Suntec Real Estate Investment Trust holds properties in Suntec City. It is Singapore's largest integrated commercial development (including one of Singapore largest shopping malls), a 66.3% interest in the Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre, a one third interest in One Raffles Quay, and a one third interest in Marina Bay Financial Centre Towers 1 and 2 and the Marina Bay Link Mall; Suntec REIT also holds a 100% interest in a commercial building located at 177 Pacific Highway, Sydney, a 100% interest in a commercial building located at 21 Harris Street, Pyrmont, Sydney, a 50.0% interest in the Southgate Complex, Melbourne, a 50.0% interest in a commercial building in Olderfleet 4…
